standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of the coherence of a pushforward to a local statement, and the description of the pushforward through the cohomology of the complement
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 1846-1850) as pointers to lemmas of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduce to a Noetherian local domain with the distinguished point in the complement.

standard_prerequisites.name: The extension of a section over a smaller open to the whole scheme after multiplication by a power of an element vanishing on the complement, and the criterion for coherence of a pushforward under a depth condition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1859-1863 and 1884-1885) as cross-chapter pointers and a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduce further to the case where the complement is the closed point, and then transfer the statement from the completion.

core_obligations: Reduce to a local domain: the proof reduces by the local nature of coherence and the description of the pushforward through the cohomology of the complement to the case of a Noetherian local domain with the closed point in the complement, and argues by induction on the dimension (proof lines 1846-1851)

Cut down the complement: passing to the punctured spectrum the induction hypothesis makes the pushforward to that open coherent, and multiplying by a power of an element vanishing on the complement extends it to a map into the structure sheaf, which is injective, so it suffices to treat the case where the complement is the closed point (proof lines 1854-1873)

Pass to the completion: the completion is universally catenary and Nagata, the dimension condition of the statement holds for it by assumption, so the coherence there follows from the general finiteness criterion for pushforwards (proof lines 1876-1887)

Descend along a faithfully flat map: flat base change identifies the pullback of the pushforward with the pushforward on the completion, and faithful flatness of the completion lets the coherence descend (proof lines 1888-1895)
proof_roadmap: 先化归：由凝聚性的局部性质与 H1 局部化的描述，可设 (A,m) 是 Noetherian 局部整环且 m ∈ Z，并对 d = dim A 归纳。
对穿孔谱 V = Spec A ∖ {m} 用归纳假设得 j'_*O_U 凝聚；取非零 f ∈ A 在 Z 上为零，则 f^n 把 j'_*O_U 映入 O_V 的单射，于是只需处理 Z = {m} 的情形。
再令 X^ = Spec A^，由假设知 finiteness-pushforward 的条件 (3) 对 X^ 成立，故 (U^→X^)_*O_{U^} 凝聚；由平坦 base change 与忠实平坦下降得 j_*O_U 凝聚。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement proves the coherence of the pushforward of the structure sheaf from the complement of a closed subset in an integral locally Noetherian scheme, under the assumption that every associated prime of the completion at a point of the complement has quotient of dimension at least two (author lemma at source lines 1835-1843, label lemma-sharp-finiteness-pushforward). The proof (source lines 1845-1896) reduces to a Noetherian local domain with the closed point in the complement and argues by induction on the dimension: passing to the punctured spectrum uses the induction hypothesis and an extension by a power of an element vanishing on the complement to reduce to the case where the complement is the closed point (proof lines 1854-1873), and the general case is then transferred from the completion, which is universally catenary and Nagata, using flat base change and faithful flat descent (proof lines 1876-1895). The induction together with the reduction to the completion is the content. H3.
